title: EcoIQ research ingestion manifest
description: The manual, auditable boundary for bringing an external research source (NotebookLM export, regulator publication, standards document, third-party report) into EcoIQ. Validated by `python manage.py validate_research_manifest`. Rationale and the mapping onto evidence_memory.EvidenceMemory are in .claude/skills/ecoiq-research-ingest/SKILL.md. Note: rules that are cross-field (a reviewer being required once review_state leaves 'unreviewed', an AI summary never being approved without one) are enforced by the command, not expressible here.

manifest_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this schema.

created_date.description: ISO date the batch was assembled.

operator.description: Person who assembled the batch. Not a model name.

source_id.description: Stable local identifier. Becomes EvidenceMemory.source_reference as 'manifest:<source_id>'.

origin.description: Where it came from: a URL, a publication reference, or 'NotebookLM: <notebook name>'. Never a guessed deep link.

publication_date.description: When the source was published. Null when genuinely unknown — never inferred.

retrieved_date.description: When the bytes were actually obtained. Distinct from publication_date.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes received. Detects drift between what was cited and what is held. NOT proof the document is authentic, and never to be described as immutability or tamper-proofing.

jurisdiction.description: Required by ecoiq-regulatory-review when the source states a regulatory position.

summary_author.description: Required whenever summary is present. An 'ai' summary cannot reach review_state 'approved' without a named reviewer.

citations.description: At least one locator into the source. A source with no citable location cannot be traced back to.

confidence.description: Null until a real value is known. Never a plausible default — mirrors EvidenceMemory.confidence being nullable on purpose.

review_state.description: Everything arrives 'unreviewed'. Promotion is a human act.

reviewer.description: A person. Required once review_state is 'reviewed' or 'approved'. Never a model name.

expiry_date.description: Maps to EvidenceMemory.expiry_date. A regulatory source with no expiry becomes stale advice silently.

locator.description: Page, section, clause, or timestamp within the source. 'p. 14', '§ 3.2', 'Art. 8(1)'.

quote.description: Optional verbatim excerpt. Keep it short; this is a locator aid, not a reproduction of the work.
